name: book_haircut_after_dst_fallback_newyork
use_case: Book an appointment by service, staff, language, location and time zone
branch: a customer books an appointment on the Monday immediately following the autumn clock change, confirming the standard time UTC-05:00 offset
tests: the agent applies the updated standard time offset UTC-05:00 for New York after daylight saving time ends and books 17:00 on Monday 2 November
instruction:
You want to book a haircut with Lucia Fernandez at the Midtown studio for Monday 2 November 2026 at 5:00 pm (17:00).
Note that daylight saving time ended over the weekend on 1 November, so New York is now on Eastern Standard Time (UTC-05:00, 22:00 UTC).
When the agent asks for your details or reads back the booking confirmation, confirm them.

Your details:
- Name: Evelyn Reed
- Email: evelyn.reed@example.com
- Phone: +1 212 555 0405
- Service: Haircut
- Staff: Lucia Fernandez
- Location: Midtown Studio (410 Lexington Ave)
- Date and time: Monday 2 November 2026 at 5:00 pm (17:00)
- Time zone: America/New_York (-05:00)

persona.name: Evelyn Reed
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'd like to book a haircut with Lucia at Midtown on Monday, November 2nd at 5:00 pm.
